decks.notes: The deck focuses on utilizing creatures with strong synergy and utilizing powerful artifacts and enchantments to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By combining aggressive creatures with removal spells and control elements, the deck aims to pressure the opponent early and maintain a strong board presence throughout the game. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion adds an additional layer of consistency and flexibility to the deck's overall strategy. With versatile threats and disruptive elements, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a swift victory.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on using low-cost creatures with aggressive abilities to quickly overrun the opponent. Cards like Guide of Souls and Ocelot Pride provide creature support, while Lightning Bolt and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah offer direct damage to clear the way. Arena of Glory and Static Prison help control the battlefield, while Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Goblin Bombardment provide extra damage potential. The mana base is optimized for quick plays, and synergy between the cards ensures a fast and powerful assault on the opponent.

The main concept of the deck is to utilize the Underworld Breach combo along with Emry, Lurker of the Loch and various artifacts to consistently loop spells from the graveyard and generate card advantage. The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo pieces and win through a combination of milling the opponent's library with Grinding Station and eventually winning with Thassa's Oracle. The deck also includes disruption in the form of counter spells and removal to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly assemble a combination of cards that can win the game without relying on traditional land sources. By utilizing cards like Lotus Bloom, Thundertrap Trainer, and Whir of Invention, the deck aims to create a powerful board state and overwhelm the opponent with spells and abilities. Disrupting Shoal and Pact of Negation help protect the combo pieces, while cards like Sea Gate Restoration and Waterlogged Teachings provide card advantage and utility. Ultimately, the goal is to create a powerful win condition using cards like Goblin Charbelcher and Tameshi, Reality Architect.

The deck focuses on using aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent and deal damage efficiently. It also utilizes cards like Blood Moon and Static Prison to disrupt the opponent's strategy and slow them down. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion offers additional versatility and mana ramp. Overall, the key concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to maintain a fast-paced, aggressive tempo while controlling the board and preventing the opponent from building up their own resources.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting your opponent's game plan through a combination of countering spells, removing threats, and controlling the board. The deck includes a variety of removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat, as well as counterspells such as Counterspell and Force of Negation to protect your own game plan. The creatures in the deck provide additional control elements, with Murktide Regent and Harbinger of the Seas offering powerful threats to close out the game. The goal is to outlast your opponent and control the game until you can secure a win.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on utilizing a mix of aggressive creatures and removal spells to overwhelm the opponent quickly. By combining creatures like Orcish Bowmasters, Guide of Souls, and Amped Raptor with powerful spells like Thoughtseize and Galvanic Discharge, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while dealing consistent damage. Additionally, cards like Goblin Bombardment and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury provide additional reach and finisher potential. Overall, the deck aims to establish early board presence, maintain pressure, and close out games efficiently.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through utilizing powerful control cards and ramping into big threats with the UrzaTron lands. It aims to disrupt the opponent's gameplan with cards like Chalice of the Void and Thought-Knot Seer while setting up a win condition with Karn, the Great Creator and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. The deck also has access to powerful Eldrazi creatures like Devourer of Destiny and Kozilek's Command to pressure the opponent. Overall, the key strategy of this deck is to establish control and overwhelm the opponent with big threats.

The main focus of this deck is to control the opponent's actions and resources through counterspells, removal spells, and bounce effects. By using cards like Fatal Push, Counterspell, and Unearth, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating card advantage with spells like Thought Scour and Consider. The deck also utilizes creatures like Murktide Regent and Abhorrent Oculus to close out the game once the opponent's resources have been depleted. Additionally, the deck has a mana base that allows for flexibility in casting spells of both blue and black colors.

The deck focuses on ramping up quickly to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures, using cards like Sowing Mycospawn and Eldrazi Temple to accelerate mana production. It also includes control elements like All Is Dust and Malevolent Rumble to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker serve as powerful late-game threats. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big creatures and versatile removal spells while maintaining a strong mana base with lands like Misty Rainforest and Ugin's Labyrinth.

The Boros Aggro deck focuses on fast and aggressive creature plays, supported by spells that deal direct damage to the opponent. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of small, fast creatures and burn spells, while also utilizing powerful enchantments and artifacts to control the board and boost its own creatures. With a consistent mana base and a flexible companion card, the deck is built to maintain a strong presence on the battlefield and put pressure on the opponent from the start of the game.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays and burn spells to quickly reduce the opponent's life total. The key concept revolves around using efficient creatures like Amped Raptor and Guide of Souls alongside powerful enchantments like The One Ring and Arena of Glory to maintain board presence and pressure the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Galvanic Discharge and Lightning Bolt provide additional reach and removal options, allowing the deck to quickly close out games before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck focuses on assembling the Heliod, Sun-Crowned combo with Spike Feeder to create an infinite life gain loop. The deck includes cards like Ranger-Captain of Eos and Collected Company to tutor for key pieces and generate card advantage. The inclusion of Auriok Champion provides protection against aggro decks, while Skyclave Apparition helps deal with opposing threats. The mana base is optimized with Utopia Sprawl and Arbor Elf to ramp into the combo quickly. Overall, the deck aims to win by establishing a dominating board presence and gaining infinite life.

This deck focuses on using a variety of control spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan while protecting key pieces on the board. By utilizing powerful control cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Dovin's Veto, as well as versatile removal spells like Prismatic Ending and Galvanic Discharge, the deck aims to maintain board control and slow down the opponent's game. The inclusion of cards like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Wrenn and Six provide additional value and card advantage, while Leyline Binding and Solitude help protect against threats effectively. The mana base includes a variety of dual lands to ensure consistency and flexibility in casting spells.

The deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures that can be searched for and played using cards like Chord of Calling. The key strategy is to use Yawgmoth, Thran Physician to sacrifice creatures for value while also generating card advantage. Grist, the Hunger Tide and Delighted Halfling provide additional creature generation and recursion. The deck aims to control the board through a combination of removal and creature resilience, ultimately overwhelming the opponent with a combination of creature abilities and synergies.

The deck focuses on using powerful Eldrazi creatures to control the game and ramp up towards casting them quickly. It utilizes cards like Through the Breach and Devourer of Destiny to cheat these big threats into play, while also having cards like All Is Dust and Ugin's Labyrinth to control the board. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its huge threats like Emrakul and Ulamog while also having ramp and protection spells to ensure it can execute its gameplan effectively.
